summary: Haskoning is international engineering and consultancy firm from the Netherlands, founded in 2012. Type: private company. About 7,798 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 8 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 4 about acquisitions; 2 about growth or hiring.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants

LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: Dutch engineering consultancy for water, buildings, transport and energy; IND sponsor with English-friendly engineering jobs and internships, and expanding through acquisitions.

culture.text: About 6,800 professionals working on climate resilience, water, energy and mobility projects, with the purpose 'Enhancing Society Together'.
Staff come mainly from TU Delft, Wageningen, TU Eindhoven, Utrecht and HU, studying civil, mechanical and environmental engineering.
7 of its 8 jobs are in engineering, mostly in Delft, with 4 internships.
Independent with no external shareholders, founded in 1881 and a Royal company since 1981.

open.text: Haskoning Nederland B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
None of its 8 jobs here require Dutch, though none mention visa support; 38% show pay.
Has offices across Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa, the Middle East and the Americas.

growth.text: Bought Dutch engineering firm Nelissen, adding 70 building specialists.
Expanded its Utrecht office to 2,400 m².
Is renting new office space in The City Post Oost in Zwolle.

worth_knowing.text: The Nelissen deal in Eindhoven is its third acquisition this year, as it aims to grow its advisory work.
